description: Payee risk check. Screens a payee wallet address and name against the OFAC SDN sanctions list and checks the merchant domain's registration age and DNS. Returns risk low|medium|high|unknown with flags such as sanctioned_address, sanctioned_name_possible, new_domain. Call this before a USDC payment when you only have a payee name, wallet or domain. Provide at least one of domain, address, or name; inputs may be combined, and domain accepts a hostname or URL. For an x402 challenge or cart and an allow/hold/block spending-rule decision, use preflight_payment instead. Price $0.01 per call (free trial first). Price: 0.01 USDC. Minimal input example: {"name":"Example Shop LLC"}. Illustrative output excerpt: {"risk":"low","flags":[],"sanctions":{"address_match":null,"name_matches":[]},"domain":null,"data_as_of":"2026-10-30T00:00:00Z","disclaimer":"Illustrative non-match, not sanctions clearance."}. Illustrative output excerpt, not a live result, signature, approval or guarantee. Freshness/data/availability checks still apply. How to pay (MCP): First use the existing shared allowance of 3 eligible calls per IP per UTC day, without payment metadata. This is shared with eligible HTTP trials, not a new allowance. Use an x402-capable MCP client. A generic MCP connector without payment support cannot complete a paid continuation. On payment required, STOP. Inspect the exact accepts amount, asset, network and payTo; obtain explicit wallet/budget approval before continuing. Only after approval, let the configured x402 MCP client attach its signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] and retry the same tools/call arguments. Never send a separate USDC transfer or paste keys into tool arguments. Never silently fall back from free access to payment. If a signed attempt has an unknown outcome, inspect that authorization/transaction; do not create another automatically.

domain.description: Merchant domain or URL, e.g. shop.example.com

name: check_payee

data_as_of.description: Timestamp of the sanctions data used

domain.description: Domain age/DNS signals, or null if no domain given

flags.description: e.g. sanctioned_address, sanctioned_name_exact, sanctioned_name_possible, new_domain, domain_no_dns

title: Check payee before paying
